structured_output.what_is_happening: SHARTCOIN (5xSY…ceji) is a 93-minute-old pair created directly on PumpSwap. It did not come from the pump.fun bonding curve: migrated_unix is 0 and launchpad is null. It is one of several SHARTCOIN/shart clones launched in the last few hours. The leader, UpBB…, is about 4 hours old with a $2.35M mcap and $686k liquidity. Another clone, C8GH…, was created about 4 minutes before this one with $1.07M in seeded liquidity and no volume. This token's liquidity ($34k) is higher than its mcap ($26k), which means the pool was seeded directly. The LP is 0% burned and unlocked, and RugCheck flags 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked' as a danger. It shows about $500k of volume in 1h, 15x turnover, and almost exactly balanced buys and sells (1455/1421). GeckoTerminal shows 1945 unique buyers over 6h but only 51 unique sellers. That looks like bot-driven or wash volume rather than organic two-way trading. Price is about 24% below its ATH, and GeckoTerminal shows -6.8% for the last hour.

narrative.description: 'Shartcoin' is a crude joke meme with earlier Truth Terminal ties. A burst of same-name clones in the last ~5 hours, including a $2M+ leader, suggests some outside trigger brought the name back. This token is a late clone, not the source of that story.
narrative.why_spreading: The name seems to be trending, so clone deployers are putting out copies to catch spillover buyers. Any attention probably goes to the leading $2M token, not this one.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is the shared ticker. It has no socials or website, and the GeckoTerminal 'twitter' field points to an unrelated YokaiCapital status post. It came 4 hours after the leading SHARTCOIN.
token_connection.competing_tokens: UpBB… (SHARTCOIN, $2.35M mcap, $686k liquidity, still trading); C8GH… (SHARTCOIN, $1.07M liquidity, created 4 min earlier); DmCU…/DQ9e… (shart, $1.4M mcap); plus several dead clones.

authenticity.evidence: Buys and sells are nearly equal at about 1,450 each per hour. There are 1945 unique buyers but only 51 unique sellers, and turnover is 15x on a $24k mcap. The pool was seeded directly with liquidity above mcap and the LP left unlocked, and the creator account is already closed. GMGN shows zero smart, renowned or KOL wallets and zero degen calls. The pattern fits volume bots or a spread-out buyer farm on a clone token.
authenticity.uncertainty: GeckoTerminal caps its unique-trader counts at 50 in short windows, so the seller figure may be understated. GMGN shows no bundler or sniper tags, which slightly weakens the manipulation case.

structural_risks: The LP is unlocked with 0% burned, and liquidity above mcap makes pulling it very profitable
The pool was seeded directly on PumpSwap by a creator account that is now closed (a common clone-rug pattern)
Many same-ticker clones, including a much larger leader that will take most of the flow
Volume looks wash- or bot-driven, so price may not hold once the bots stop
Doubling needs roughly $52k mcap against deep liquidity, which takes a lot of real buying

structured_output.counterargument: About 1,950 holders with a spread-out top 10 (about 18% excluding the pool) and no insider, bundler or sniper flags could mean this is a real overflow buyer base. If the Shartcoin wave keeps heating up, a cheap $26k clone could get a spillover bid and double quickly, as it already rose 137% in 6h. Mint and freeze authorities are renounced and there is no tax.

structured_output.thesis: This is a late, unsocialized SHARTCOIN clone sitting in a directly seeded PumpSwap pool with unlocked LP. The volume looks like bots, and the price is already slipping from its ATH. The most likely outcome is an LP pull or a slow death. A double would need real spillover from the leading token, and that is unlikely.
